outcome: Oxidative stress markers in umbilical cord blood (native thiol, total thiol, disulfide, ischemia-modified albumin (IMA) levels)
cohort: The study included 131 patients, comprising 55 pregnant women with IDA and 76 low-risk controls, all delivering at >=37 weeks.
finding: Pregnant women with IDA had statistically significantly lower native thiol and total thiol values, and higher disulfide and IMA values in umbilical cord blood compared to controls, indicating increased oxidative stress.
